name: Air Charter Service
roleBasis: Its homepage calls it "The largest private charter brokerage in the world" and cites 30+ years of experience.
summary: Large global charter brokerage that takes requests by quote form and publishes no charter price on its homepage.
differentiator: Quote only. The pages we read carry no hourly rate or sample trip price, so there is nothing published to hold its quote against. It also lists empty legs and a jet card.
priceNote: The pages we read show "Get a Quote" and "Inquire Now" forms and no dollar figure for charter.
operatorDisclosure: Not stated on the pages we read.
bestFor: Buyers who already plan to collect several written quotes and want a very large broker among them.
skipIf: You want a price before you share trip details.
